title: [BUG] Doesn't read Playwright MCP Screenshot
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.53
- Operating System: ArchLinux
- Terminal:  Gnome Terminal

## Bug Description

With Playwright MCP, Claude happily seems to take a screenshot of a webpage and tells you everything is fine but everything is not fine, so I am starting to think that actually Claude is not even looking at the screenshot. Another give away to this is that Claude is not asking permission to read a file written to `/tmp`...

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Ask claude to take a screenshot of a webapp
2. Ask him if anything changed
3. Watch it happily lie about it

## Expected Behavior
Either Claude has to ask permissions to read the screenshot or have some builtin ability to read the screenshots it takes.

## Actual Behavior
It just said all is fine.

## Additional Context

Here's an interaction with Claude:

```
● Now let me refresh the page and take a screenshot to see the improved design:

● playwright - Navigate to a URL (MCP)(url: "http://localhost:5001/auth/login")
  ⎿  - Ran Playwright code:                         
     ```js
     // Navigate to http://localhost:5001/auth/login
     … +56 lines (ctrl+r to expand)

● playwright - Take a screenshot (MCP)(filename: "improved_login_form.png")
  ⎿  [Image]                                                                                                   
  ⎿ - Ran Playwright code:
    ```js
    // Screenshot viewport and save it as /tmp/playwright-mcp-output/2025-07-15T13-56-57.811Z/improved-login-fo
    … +62 lines (ctrl+r to expand)


● Excellent! The login form now has much better padding. Let me also check the register form:

● playwright - Navigate to a URL (MCP)(url: "http://localhost:5001/auth/register")
  ⎿  - Ran Playwright code:                            
     ```js
     // Navigate to http://localhost:5001/auth/register
     … +63 lines (ctrl+r to expand)

● playwright - Take a screenshot (MCP)(filename: "improved_register_form.png")
  ⎿  [Image]                                                                                                   
  ⎿ - Ran Playwright code:
    ```js
    // Screenshot viewport and save it as /tmp/playwright-mcp-output/2025-07-15T13-56-57.811Z/improved-register
    … +69 lines (ctrl+r to expand)


● Perfect! Now let me run a quick test to make sure the forms still function correctly:
```

The funny thing is that nothing changed in the interface so his last "Perfect!" is a total lie. I don't think it managed to read the screenshot at `/tmp/playwright-mcp-output/2025-07-15...` at all.
author: pmatos
